title: AI-guided screening engineers P450BM3 variants that use a biomimetic cofactor
summary: HelixWings combined conformational dynamics and static microenvironment analysis to screen enzyme variants for use with the cheap cofactor NMNH. For P450BM3 it found a variant with 404% higher catalytic efficiency toward cytochrome c under NMNH-supported conditions, and 217% better NMNH utilization was reported for CYP116B46. The authors report 23-fold shorter screening than rational design; deep learning is one step in a pipeline with molecular dynamics and energy ranking.
ai_technology: Interpretable CNN (ICNNMD) on molecular dynamics trajectories to identify residues driving NMNH-bound conformational change, followed by saturation mutagenesis ranked by constrained-MD energy

evidence.tested: Experimental enzyme kinetics of the top-ranked variants and a second enzyme.
evidence.unknown: Contribution of the learned model separate from molecular dynamics and energy ranking; the CYP116B46 figure comes from the abstract.
evidence.ai_role: Identifies residues to mutate in a screening pipeline

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
